document_description: Read `.claude/commands/eap-version.md` for the full workflow. Compare against the latest git tag (or `main` if on a feature branch). Classify changes: MAJOR for breaking changes or removed APIs, MINOR for new features/commands/skills/tools, PATCH for fixes/docs/refactors. Present the recommendation with the reasoning and offer to update version numbers in `README.md` and `.utils/pyproject.toml`.
